user.title: Haier Evo account
user.description: Use the e-mail and password of the Evo app. The password is used to sign in only and is not stored. Accounts created via Yandex ID need a password: set it with "Forgot password" in the Evo app.

init.title: Haier Evo settings
init.description: Control of washing machines and dryers is a beta: it has not been checked on a real machine yet. When it is on, every machine gets a program to start and the buttons Start, Pause, Resume and Cancel program. A command goes out only while remote control is on at the machine.
